title: Silence stronger than a spoken defense
english: Even moderate judges would marvel that the accused, able to clear himself and recount his life and God-given works, chose silence and [[held the accusers in contempt >> Bible:Matthew 27:12-14]]. Had he answered, Pilate would have released him; the silence was not weakness but greatness of soul.

title: Written apology must not weaken the apology of deeds
english: I dare say the apology you ask for can dilute the apology already in the deeds and the open power of Jesus. Still, lest we seem to shrink from your charge, we dictate answers to each of Celsus’s points — words that cannot shake anyone who [[loves God in Christ Jesus >> Bible:Romans 8:39]].

added_allusions.reason: love of God in Christ Jesus

title: Boast in tribulation; more than conquerors
english: It is fitting to [[boast in tribulation >> Bible:Romans 5:3]] that does not separate us from God’s love — yet Paul and the apostles are higher still: [[in all these things we more than conquer through him who loved us >> Bible:Romans 8:37]]. Neither death nor life nor angels can [[separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus >> Bible:Romans 8:38-39]].

title: Greek philosophy’s plausible falsehood vs Celsus
english: Paul saw how Greek philosophy can dress falsehood as truth: [[see that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deceit >> Bible:Colossians 2:8]]. Even the world’s wisdom has a certain stature, yet Celsus’s charges do not rise to that level; they are weaker than the philosophers’ elemental talk.

title: Preface for the weak in faith; PREFACE CLOSEOUT
english: This preface is set before the start after we had already dictated through Celsus’s personified Jew against Jesus, so readers see the book is not mainly for the firmly faithful but for those [[weak in faith >> Bible:Romans 14:1]] or still untasted of faith in Christ. Better still is the one who needs no apology at all, despising Celsus by the Spirit in any believer.
